shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml
cat package.json | sed -n '1,140p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md
if test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git status --short
git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix registry test lint regression" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main
if test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$(git rev-parse @{upstream})"; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
